test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Deccan Plateau is a triangular landmass in India that lies to the south of the river ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narmada: **

 
 
• **The Narmada River flows through the states of Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat,** moving **westwards over a length of about 1,312 km before emptying into the Arabian Sea in the Bharuch district of Gujarat.**
 
• This river is considered the traditional boundary between** North India and South India, with the Deccan Plateau lying south** of it. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ganga:**

 
 
• **The Ganges or Ganga** is one of the **longest rivers in India,** and it flows through the **northern part of the country**.
 
• **The Deccan Plateau** is not located south of this river; instead,** it's geographically much further south**.
 
 
 
• **Krishna:**
 
 
• **The Krishna River** is one of the major rivers in **India, flowing through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It does flow through t**he Deccan Plateau,** but it's not the river that traditionally marks the northern boundary of the plateau.
 
 
 
• **Tapi:**
 
 
• **The Tapi River (also known as Tapti)** runs in **central India between the Godavari and Narmada rivers.**
 
• It flows westwards over a **length of 724 km **before draining through the **Gulf of Khambhat into the Arabian Sea**.
